lectures.title: OSI Layer 2/7: The Data Link Layer

cues.en: Let's now have a look at the next layer.
At layer two, the so-called data link layer.
Now, we have established a physical connection between our computers.
This means that we are able to transmit single units of information or bits from one computer to other
computers.
We now have established a physical connection.
How can we now define who should receive the data?
Why is this important?
Well, let's say we have a Wi-Fi network.

and this and this computer.

This happens on the data link layer, and the units that we send here are called frames.

we send out.
How big are those frames?

there, we can imagine that a frame is about 1500 bytes in size.
